description: List every named set the agent could use with this project: sets in the user's own library (global, e.g. 'Personal fal', 'Work fal') and sets in the project's own vault. Each entry says where it lives (library or project), whether this project already uses it, and its key names. Call this when the user names a set loosely ("use my acme fal key", "the work fal account") so you can pass the right name to hush_run. Returns names only, never values.
name: hush_list_sets
